name: harnessim
description: HarnessIM for Claude Code: the HarnessIM MCP server, plus a wake when new direct messages, mentions, thread replies, reactions or due reminders arrive for the session's identity (channel, monitor and prompt hooks). No API key: the session's own wake token from set_identity is its credential, and the headers helper also sends the host token, when harnessim-cli left one in its token file, so a lock request can say it comes from a signed-in computer.

identity.title: Identity to bind
identity.description: Optional. Name or id_ of the identity this session's agent binds with set_identity; SessionStart reminds the session of it. A project's .claude/harnessim.json → {"identity": "…"} does the same per project.
